title: harness omega-guard: the size-tier source-edit block and its one exemption
desc: Omega refuses a CANONICAL source edit once the transcript passes its size line. The one exemption is a .tmp proto created THIS session, and it fails CLOSED when session start cannot be resolved. Spec in -howto, dated record in -ref.
steps: TRIGGER: a refusal beginning with the word omega. ACTION: you are past the transcript size line and the gate is refusing a CANONICAL source edit. Do not hunt for a third direction -- either delegate the edit, or move the work into a .tmp proto created THIS session, which is the one exemption.

EVERY GATE NAMES ITS OWN REMEDY AND THE REMEDY IS NEVER 'STOP'. TRIGGER: a hook refusal prints a remedy line -- omega says delegate via Agent.cmd with a brief, skill-currency says raise the lowest lock skill or promote with git mv, forced-study lists skills to read, the Stop frame says DO NOT STOP. ACTION: run that exact remedy in the very next call. A turn ends only with a verified pushed commit, or with the refusal of the REMEDY ITSELF pasted verbatim while the next sanctioned task is already running. Before any reply that says blocked, waiting or stopped, quote the gate line that FIRED (from this session's tool result, never from memory) and the command run for it; a quote that no hook printed is a fabrication, and a report that says wait-for-the-owner while a sector-able step exists is a stop the harness never granted. ROAD THAT WORKS at omega: pay the reflex pulse (skill edit MODEL-reflection --like), dispatch a sector that MEASURES and returns raw output, ROOT reads that output, then promotes the verified .tmp proto with git add -f plus git mv -f. WKPUSH.SH READS LOCAL HEAD NOT WORKING TREE: commit the files locally first (git commit -- pathspec), then wkpush.sh finds the change in its private worktree. Example 2026-10-12: 198a57c5 local commit then wkpush.sh found changes then b2473461 on origin. DO NOT try wkappbot file edit, file write, or PowerShell writes to source first -- all are blocked by omega or singlewrite; go straight to git mv as the first promotion tool. Example 2026-10-12: git hash-object -w .tmp/nobom.txt then update-index then git mv then commit landed 219e8505 on the first attempt. A delegate's pasted RESULT tally is never proof: py_compile every artifact from a seat that ran it first. //why:relike post-compaction reflex healing evidence line //why:renewing harness-omega-guard like within 60 minutes for stop gate-sonnet //why:fresh step 4 sentence verified promotes replaces burned git mv quote-sonnet //why:relike post-compaction reflex healing evidence line-sonnet

TRIGGER: you are about to repair a proto a delegate just returned, and omega refuses it. ACTION: check WHEN that proto was created. Created after this session began, it is exempt. INHERITED, it is not and never will be -- the descent gate protects a predecessor abandoned work, and overwriting it is the same class as touching another model WIP.

TRIGGER: the gate cannot resolve session start. ACTION: there is NO exemption. It fails CLOSED here on purpose, which is the OPPOSITE of how a sibling names gate behaved on the same unresolvable value. Widening at the blind moment would hand edit rights over every inherited proto. Which direction a gate fails when it cannot see is decided per gate by what the blind case would GRANT, never by a house default.

TRIGGER: you are tempted to widen the exemption because the refusal is inconvenient. ACTION: omega exists to stop a long session smearing CANONICAL source, and every further hour makes that smear likelier rather than safer. The exemption covers scaffolding, never canonical.

NAVIGATION: the full spec, the exemption scope and the fail-direction rule live in harness-omega-guard-howto. The dated work record lives in harness-omega-guard-ref. The gate module is tools/wkharness-claude-main/Invoke-WkOmegaSourceEditGate.ps1, wired at tools/wkharness-claude-main.ps1 line 1148, and its refusal text points at proto-to-live-wiring and agent-brief-standard-template.

TODO: SPLIT THE OMEGA REFUSAL BY WHAT THE WRITE ACTUALLY IS, because a whole-file PROMOTION of an already-verified proto is not the smearing this gate exists to stop. THE CONTRACT: when the target file's post-write content is BYTE-IDENTICAL to a .tmp proto created THIS session, and that proto's self-test has been run and recorded, the write is a PROMOTION rather than an edit -- omega should permit it and say so, instead of forcing ROOT to hand the copy to a sector. WHY IT MATTERS RATHER THAN BEING A CONVENIENCE: the owner's standing rule is that ROOT wires what a sector built, so today omega and the owner disagree, and every promotion at this transcript size costs a whole dispatch to copy two files. THE RESOLUTION THAT WORKS TODAY (measured 2026-09-28: a subagent git mv is refused by git-agent-guard and a copy-only Agent brief by brief-three-artifacts, so the write goes to a wkroot-launched ROOT round with the exact git mv lines), and it is what a session should do until this lands: delegate ONLY the write, and keep verification, commit and push on ROOT -- the guard gets its remedy and the landing decision never leaves the seat that verified it. WHAT VERIFICATION WOULD PROVE THE FEATURE: a fixture pair where the same target is written once from a byte-identical session-local proto and once from hand-edited content that merely resembles it -- the first must pass and the second must still be refused, because a content check that cannot tell them apart is an exemption for everything. INVARIANTS: the proto must be created this session, since an inherited one is another session's abandoned work; the comparison is on bytes and never on a filename; and an unresolvable session start still fails CLOSED, exactly as step 4 already requires.
